meta.title: Welpco — Welper Guide
meta.description: How to set up your Stripe payouts, receive bookings, use the Marketplace, keep your profile up to date, and build your reputation on Welpco.

hero.title: Welcome to your Welpco guide
hero.subtitle: Getting set up on the platform — profile, payouts, bookings, and the Marketplace.

intro: Thank you for being part of the Welpco community!
This guide was created to help you get started on the platform and better understand how to use your account.
overview.tocLead: Inside, you’ll find essential information on how to:

items.label: complete the final steps of your profile
understand how to receive service requests
provide a professional experience to your clients

sections.title: Complete Your Stripe Setup to Receive Payments

blocks.text: Welpco uses Stripe to process payments securely.
If you have not already done so, you will need to complete your Stripe account setup in order to receive payments directly into your bank account.

Since July 11, 2026, a completed Stripe payout account is required to accept bookings — not just to receive payments. Complete your Stripe setup now so you can accept bookings as soon as they come in.
During the creation of your Welper profile, you will be prompted to set up your Stripe account. Once your account has been created, simply follow the instructions below:

items: Personal Details: for the Job Title field, you may enter “Self-Employed” or a more specific title such as “Dog Walker,” “House Cleaner,” “Cook,” etc.

Business Information: for Industry, select “Personal Services – Other Personal Services”; for Website, enter www.welpco.com; for Product/Service Description, provide a brief description of the services you offer.
Banking Information: enter your personal bank account details to receive your weekly payouts directly into your account.

blocks.text: A background check is not required to be visible on Welpco.
However, completing one can help you stand out to clients and increase their confidence in your profile.
Welpers who have completed a background check may be viewed as more trustworthy by some clients, particularly for in-home services, babysitting, family assistance, or pet care services.

sections.title: Browse Available Opportunities in the Marketplace

blocks.text: In addition to being visible to clients, you can also browse opportunities posted in the Marketplace tab.
In this section, you will find requests from clients who are actively looking for a Welper.
You can review the details of each opportunity and apply to the ones that match your services, availability, and service area.

sections.title: Receiving a Booking from a Client

blocks.text: When a client books your services, you will receive a notification.
You will then be able to review the booking details, including:

items: any important information provided by the client.

blocks.text: Always take the time to carefully review the request before confirming.

sections.title: When a Client Selects You for a Service (when you apply for a job)

blocks.text: If a client selects you for a service, you will be notified through the platform.
Make sure to:

items: communicate with the client if you have any questions;
review the address, date, time, and service details;
complete the service professionally and respectfully.

blocks.text: Good communication and reliability help create a positive experience and increase your chances of receiving great reviews and future bookings.

sections.title: Keep Your Profile Up to Date

blocks.text: To increase your chances of receiving bookings, make sure your profile remains complete and up to date:
The more complete and accurate your profile is, the more confidence clients will have when choosing your services.
Once the service has been completed, make sure to follow the required steps within the platform.
You will be asked to submit your start and end times so that Welpco can accurately process the booking and generate the customer invoice when applicable.
Clients will have the opportunity to leave a review on your profile, which can help you receive more bookings in the future.
You will also be able to rate and review the customer based on your experience.
Providing excellent service, communicating clearly, and being punctual are some of the best ways to build a strong reputation on Welpco.

support.title: Need Help?
support.text: If you have any questions or need assistance with your profile, Stripe setup, bookings, or the Marketplace, don’t hesitate to contact us.
closing: We’re here to help and support you every step of the way.
Thank you for being part of the Welpco community!
